title: AWR Capacity - Tablespaces
description: Tablespace usage from AWR: observed daily, forecast to a year out, days to full, and the growth days the anomaly layer flagged.

panels.title: Tablespaces CRIT
panels.description: Latest fit says full in 30 days or less (or already past the near-full line).

panels.title: Growth anomalies in range
panels.description: Days whose growth rate was far outside the tablespace's own median rate (robust z-score), one per day and baseline mode (trailing, same weekday).

panels.title: Days to full (latest fit per tablespace, soonest first)
panels.description: Days to full is the linear fit projected at today's slope; low/high come from the forecast band. CRIT at 30 days or less, WARN at 90.

panels.title: Used space: observed, forecast (dashed), anomalies (red)
panels.description: Left of today: observed daily used bytes. Right of today: the REGR forecast (dashed) with its low/high band (dotted). Grey dashed: the ceiling (MAXBYTES or operator override). Red dots and red markers: growth anomalies; hover a marker for the explanation.

panels.title: Daily growth (sum of selected tablespaces; red = flagged day)
panels.description: Per-day growth summed over the selected tablespaces. A red bar is the growth of the tablespaces flagged that day; the grey line is the sum of their median daily growth, which the anomaly test measures against.
